environment: Two hosted Supabase projects; GoTrue, PostgREST, Edge and Storage HTTP
checks: Original Auth UUIDs sign in to both projects using distinct new passwords
A source token cannot authenticate against the recovery project
Source work includes two inspection versions, original photo, time and immutable note
Complete export excludes Auth and preserves documents, photos, inspection history and audit
Recovery restores original rows once under a new authenticated device
Historical devices and old acknowledgements never become active authority
Recording work is blocked while recovered photo originals are missing
Photo restoration preserves immutable path, bytes, hash and current permissions
Recovered export keeps the exact document, operation identities, technical versions and audit originals
Sign-out revokes fresh RPC and private photo reads in the recovered project
